title: VK-only Write Single Register with nondefault transaction and register value
purpose: Provide a distinct mutation-friendly server request for the single-register reply path, retaining a compact valid structure while changing address and data fields.

messages.label: write single register at address 100 with patterned value

expected_behavior: A conforming server should accept or reject the address according to its mapping and return either the normal echoed write response or a Modbus exception response without terminating the connection.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches the unit identifier and Write Single Register PDU.
The request uses a valid two-byte register address and two-byte register value.
issue_safety_notes: The crafted-request and test-server evidence motivates coverage of the reply/parser path, but this candidate is not the documented historical byte sequence and no crash outcome is claimed.
